name: Manchester Parks & Recreation Summer Camp
description_short: The Town of Manchester's summer day camp, in two age groups: Battenkill Adventurers for ages 5 to 8 (up to 30 campers) and Equinox Explorers for ages 9 to 11 (up to 20 campers).
notes: The page says weekly rates are $250 to $300 based on residency; $300 is taken as the non-resident rate and $250 as the resident rate. Registration opened January 1 for Manchester residents and January 8 for non-residents. Camp ran June 22 to August 14, 2026. Not the Manchester, NH camps.
